rules.source_statement: The source says Virgo rising was most afflicted by the corporeal presence of Mars, described as partly lord of the eighth house.
preconditions: Virgo is the ascendant of the current printed figure.
Mars is present by body, not merely by aspect.
Mars is described as partly eighth-house lord.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Astrological affliction is authorial, not a measured clinical symptom.
This house-rulership description must not be strengthened into unconditional ruler of the whole eighth.

preconditions: Uses the preceding source-defined ascendant/Mars/eighth configuration.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is a conditional 1647 horary inference, not a diagnosis or independently observed illness.
No modern body-map transfer without separate validated procedure.
The antecedent of 'from that house and Signe' is ambiguous between ascendant sign and eighth-house relation.
Require means seek or inquire, not a validated physical diagnosis.

rules.source_statement: The author says he did not perceive 'by naturall causes' that the patient could live above ten or twelve days.
preconditions: Bounded to this single case and the depicted question context.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Ten OR twelve days is the source expression, not a probability distribution.
It appears earlier in the printed narration than the stated death, but the publication is retrospective, without a preserved contemporaneous forecast or independent testimony.
Source never states from what exact moment ten or twelve days are counted, or inclusive/exclusive conventions.

rules.source_statement: Reason one: Sun was temporal light of the enquiry, 'is (fons vitalis potentiæ)', in perfect square to Saturn sixth-house ruler, both in fixed signs.
preconditions: Sun square Saturn, fixed-sign configuration, and Saturn's role as sixth lord.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Latin is printed source wording, not independent measured influence.
Source perfect square not reproduced against a verified historical ephemeris.
The past tense was and present is belong to different clauses.
